# Security Policy

## Scope

TinyCore-8 is an educational Verilog and processor-design repository. Security reports may concern repository infrastructure, unsafe scripts, exposed credentials, or other vulnerabilities affecting project users.

Functional bugs in Verilog designs should normally be reported through the bug report issue template.

## Supported versions

The latest code on the `main` branch is the only actively maintained version.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not publish sensitive vulnerability details in a public issue.

Contact the project maintainer through:

https://github.com/chetanrmaradi

Include:
- A clear description of the potential vulnerability.
- Steps to reproduce it, if safe to do so.
- The files or components affected.
- Any suggested mitigation.

Do not include passwords, access tokens, private keys, or other secrets in a report.

## Response

The maintainer will review the report and may ask for additional information. As this is a student learning project, response and remediation timelines are not guaranteed. Please allow reasonable time for review before public disclosure.
